name: Seeking Gods Will
overview: Scripture teaches that seeking God's will requires wholehearted pursuit and trust in His purposes, as Jeremiah 29:13 promises that those who search for God with all their heart will find Him. Jesus exemplifies this in Matthew 26:39 and John 5:30 by submitting His own desires to the Father's will, showing that true obedience involves surrender rather than self-will. Believers are called to prioritize God's kingdom and righteousness above all else (Matthew 6:33), trusting that God works all things for good according to His purpose (Romans 8:28). The Spirit also intercedes for believers in alignment with God's will, revealing the divine mind to those who seek Him (Romans 8:27).
